messages:
emma (Billing): heads-up — Neptune Labs (acct NEPT-1023) payment declined this morning, CC failed on scheduled charge for invoice INV-2024-09-431 ($78,450). They emailed asking to split into 3 installments.
ben (AE): thx emma, i spoke with their finance lead (carl). they're pushing for a 90-day net w/ 3 payments. said product is mission-critical so churn risk if we push too hard. :grimacing:
raj (Collections): copy. can we confirm usage/overage reconciliation? last month's usage spiked due to eval batch jobs — want to avoid waiving legitimate charges before recon.
ben (AE): i pulled their usage — spike between 2024-09-05 and 2024-09-09 from a test job they forgot to disable. looks like ~35% of invoice is from that window. i'll ask them to approve a corrected usage file.
emma (Billing): ok don't send dunning yet. if they sign a payment plan we'll hold off. but finance needs a formal commit. ben, can you get a signed email and preferred payment dates? also how do we handle taxes/refunds if we adjust?
ben (AE): will do. proposed schedule: 30/30/40 split, first payment due 7 days from signed agreement. i'll draft email now and cc finance.
support-bot: Automated: retrying card charge for INV-2024-09-431 — attempt 2/3 failed (auth decline). Reason: issuer flagged as "possible fraud". Retry scheduled in 24h.
raj (Collections): if they want split, we need a signed payment plan doc + card on file OR ACH mandate. for ACH we'll need the bank's micro-deposit verification — that's 2-3 days.
lena (Legal): quick flag from legal — if we accept a split plan we should include a clause that reverts to immediate collection on any missed installment and keeps original termination rights. i'll draft a short addendum. also CC compliance for PII in payment docs.
ben (AE): sharing draft payment plan here for comments:
```
Payment Plan: Invoice INV-2024-09-431 ($78,450)
Schedule: 2024-10-05 $23,535 | 2024-11-05 $23,535 | 2024-12-05 $31,380
Conditions: Signed email + payment method on file; missed payment => 7-day cure window then immediate collections escalation.
```
emma (Billing): looks fine, add: "no additional credits applied" and require invoice reconciliation confirmation from customer before first payment.
raj (Collections): agree. once signed i'll set up a payment plan in the billing system and pause automated dunning. attaching internal checklist: need signed email, reconciliation confirmation, and payment method token.
ben (AE): carl replied — they accept 30/30/40 and will provide a signed confirmation by EOD. said ACH preferred. asked whether we can backdate first payment to 2024-10-01 — they have cash coming in then.
emma (Billing): ACH preferred is fine but note verification timeline. propose: 1) customer signs payment plan email 2) we provision a 7-day provisional hold on collection 3) first payment due 10/01 via ACH; if ACH not verified by then, fallback to card retry and immediate attempt.
lena (Legal): sounds good. i'll attach the one-paragraph addendum to ben's email and cc compliance.
dunning-bot: Automated reminder queued for INV-2024-09-431 on 2139880143 unless payment plan flag set.
raj (Collections): once i get signed email, i'll set the "payment_plan:pending" flag to prevent dunning-bot from firing. ben, please drop the signed text in this thread or DM me.
ben (AE): will do. thanks everyone — i'll update here when i have the signed confirmation from Carl. :thumbsup:
